show.description: When Ananya Rathore, a strong yet vulnerable young woman, is crushed under Aarav Thakur’s cruelty, she unexpectedly crosses paths with the powerful Rivan Singh Raizada. Between betrayal, debt, and a battle for dignity, Ananya must decide if her broken pieces can turn into her greatest strength or her deepest downfall. Watch now!
